title: chamaemelum coronarium
intro: Chamaemelum coronarium, commonly known as Chamomile, is a low-growing, perennial herb in the daisy family (Asteraceae). The health benefits of Chamomile include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and promote relaxation, making it a popular natural remedy for anxiety and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of Chamomile include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties, which help to calm the nervous system and reduce muscle tension. The bioactive constituents of Chamomile include apigenin, luteolin, and chamazulene, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its calming and soothing effects.
